faqs.q: What exactly is posture correction chiropractic?
faqs.a: Unlike massage or stretching that temporarily loosen tight muscles, structural chiropractic targets the skeletal compensations that force your muscles to overwork. When your spine and posture are correctly aligned, muscles no longer need to strain to hold you upright — and chronic tension resolves at its source.

faqs.q: How many sessions will I need?
faqs.a: Most clients begin noticing real structural change within 3–7 sessions. The exact number depends on how long the pattern has been established and how your body responds. Dr. Roy will give you a clear, personalized care plan after your first visit.

faqs.q: Is Standwell different from regular chiropractic?
faqs.a: Yes. Standwell focuses on structural posture correction — addressing the underlying skeletal collapses that drive recurring pain and tension. This is proactive, corrective care rather than repeated visits for temporary symptom management.

faqs.q: Does Dutch health insurance cover chiropractic care?
faqs.a: Chiropractic care may be covered under Dutch supplemental health insurance (aanvullende verzekering). Coverage varies by insurer and policy level. Many Dutch insurers reimburse registered chiropractors — Dr. Roy Hammond, DC is a registered practitioner. Check your policy or call your insurer to confirm.

faqs.q: What happens at the first visit?
faqs.a: Your first visit is 60 minutes and costs €95. It includes a full patient history review, posture analysis with photographs, your first structural correction, a report of findings, and a personalized care plan. You'll leave understanding exactly what is happening in your body and what the path forward looks like.

Standwell is located at Papaverhof 71, Suite 1008, 1032 LX Amsterdam (Amsterdam-Noord). Accessible via M52 metro (Noorderpark station) and bus lines 391, 394, and 35 (Floraweg stop). Ample public parking is available nearby.
